items.description: Sec. 2.3 and Sec. 4 give only a 100×100-element grid ('fixed domain of 100×100'); no length, height or units are stated, and the geometry is otherwise only drawn in Fig. 1(a). With top88's unit square elements this means a square domain (1:1) with rmin measured in element widths, so only the absolute size is open.
readings: square, 100 × 100 length units (unit square elements, top88 convention; rmin = 2.4)
square, 1 × 1 (element size 0.01, rmin = 0.024)
any other square L × L on the same 100×100 grid

items.description: Sec. 2.1/3.1 only say 'cantilever beam (Fig. 1(a))', solved with top88. Which edge is fixed, and over what length, is shown only in Fig. 1(a). Stock top88 solves the half MBB beam, so the cantilever BCs were user-modified and are not set by the listed inputs {penal, rmin, ft}.
readings: entire left edge (x = 0, 0 ≤ y ≤ H) fixed, as in the top88 cantilever: fixeddofs = 1:2*(nely+1)
only part of the left edge fixed (e.g., a central segment)
entire right edge fixed with the load on the left edge (mirror image)

items.entity: restraint type on the supported edge
items.description: The text never says which DOFs are restrained. 'Cantilever' suggests a clamp, but the support symbol appears only in Fig. 1(a).
readings: clamped: ux = uy = 0 at all nodes of the supported edge
partial restraint: ux = 0 along the edge, uy = 0 only at a single node (roller-type)

items.entity: tip load on the free end
items.description: Sec. 2.1 and 3.1 give no load location; it is shown only in Fig. 1(a).
readings: bottom-right corner (x/L = 1, y/H = 0); top88 short cantilever, F at DOF 2*(nelx+1)*(nely+1)
mid-height of the right edge (x/L = 1, y/H = 0.5)
top-right corner (x/L = 1, y/H = 1)

items.entity: tip load on the free end
items.description: The load direction is never stated. 'Cantilever beam' implies a transverse load, but the arrow is only in Fig. 1(a).
readings: vertical, downward (−y)
vertical, upward (+y): gives the same optimal layout and compliance, because compliance is quadratic in F
inclined or horizontal, if drawn that way in Fig. 1(a)

items.entity: tip load on the free end
items.description: The text does not say whether the load is a single nodal force or spread over a patch or edge (Fig. 1(a) only).
readings: single nodal point force (top88 convention)
force spread over a few adjacent nodes around the load point
uniform shear traction over the whole free (right) edge

items.entity: tip load on the free end
items.description: No load value is given anywhere in the text.
readings: F = 1 (top88 unit load)
any physical value, e.g., 1 N or 1 kN

items.entity: volume constraint of the cantilever run
items.description: Sec. 2.3 says designs were generated for Vf = 0.01:0.01:0.95, but also says a narrower range may be used if this 'proves challenging', without saying which range was actually used. Table 1 reports only Vf = 0.03, 0.25, 0.50 and 0.75, and the Vf of the cantilever target in Fig. 3(b) is not stated. 'This example' therefore has no single volume fraction.

items.entity: solid Young's modulus E0 and out-of-plane thickness
items.description: The text gives no elastic constants or thickness (only penal = 3); top88 defaults are implied but not stated.
readings: E0 = 1, unit thickness (top88 defaults)
physical values, e.g., E0 = 210 GPa, t = 1 mm

items.description: Not stated anywhere. top88's element stiffness matrix uses ν = 0.3 in plane stress.
readings: ν = 0.3, plane stress (top88)
ν = 0.3, plane strain
other ν (e.g., 0.25 or 1/3), plane stress

items.description: Sec. 2.3 gives only penal = 3. The minimum stiffness Emin, or a lower bound on density, is not stated.
readings: modified SIMP E = Emin + x^3 (E0 − Emin), Emin = 1e-9·E0 (top88)
classic SIMP E = x^3·E0 with x_min = 1e-3 (top99 style)
Emin = 1e-6·E0 or 1e-3·E0

items.description: No passive regions are mentioned, and the domain is described only by Fig. 1(a). Stock top88 has none.
readings: none: all 100×100 elements designable
small solid non-design pad at the load point and/or along the fixed edge, if drawn in Fig. 1(a)

items.entity: optimizer, move limit and initial design
items.description: Sec. 2.3 lists only {penal = 3, rmin = 2.4, ft = 1} for top88. The update scheme, move limit and starting design are not stated (top88 defaults implied).
readings: OC: move limit 0.2, damping exponent 0.5, bisection on the Lagrange multiplier; uniform start x = Vf (top88 defaults)
MMA from a uniform start x = Vf

items.description: maxit = 100 is given only for TOPress (Sec. 2.3). For top88 no stopping rule or iteration cap is stated; top88 itself has no maxit input and loops until max|Δx| ≤ 0.01.
readings: top88 default: stop when max|Δx| ≤ 0.01, no iteration cap
cap at 100 iterations, as stated for TOPress
tighter tolerance, e.g., max|Δx| ≤ 0.001
